signal: CADDi deepened its Google Cloud partnership and joined the Google Cloud Marketplace, on top of a $38M Series C extension led by Atomico

email.subject1: a signal play for CADDi's partners
email.body1:
Tak, saw CADDi deepened its Google Cloud partnership and joined the Marketplace after the Series C extension.

Co-sell coverage rarely scales with the partner ecosystem, the team simply cannot touch every joint account a partner like Google opens up. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously across the partner ecosystem, so co-sell coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for CADDi's partner ecosystem off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: drafts to your top partner targets
email.body2:
Tak, quick follow-up for CADDi.

Marketplace momentum opens far more co-sell accounts than a partnerships team can personally work, and partner-sourced pipeline stalls when nobody can follow up at scale. The answer is coverage per person, not more headcount.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three co-sell targets in the Google Cloud ecosystem. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body3:
Tak, last bit of proof for CADDi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how CADDi's partner-sourced reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage platforms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tak, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling co-sell coverage without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Standing up Marketplace motions is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page co-sell pilot playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to CADDi's partner ecosystem? I will tailor it to you either way.
